What is the difference between raise and assert?

Supplied answer
raise deliberately throws an exception, and is the normal way to signal invalid input in production code:
raise ValueError("Age cannot be negative"). assert checks a condition and raises AssertionError if it is
False; it is meant for debugging and internal checks, and it is removed when Python runs with the -O
flag, so never use assert for input validation.
